name: TradingAgents
description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework. Specialized LLM agents (fundamentals, sentiment, news, technical) debate and inform trading decisions.
one_liner: A team of AI agents that play the roles of a real trading firm (analysts, trader, risk manager) and debate before suggesting a trade. Built for research, not real money.
buyer: Fintech builders and finance educators who want to demonstrate or research AI-driven analysis, and content creators in the investing space.
business_use_cases: A finance newsletter uses it to generate a daily 'what the AI analysts debated about this stock' segment.
A fintech startup studies it to prototype an AI research assistant for retail investors, with heavy compliance guardrails.
A business school runs it as a teaching tool to show how fundamental, sentiment, and technical views combine.

money_ideas.idea: An AI 'research briefing' subscription that summarizes the multi-agent analysis for a watchlist, clearly labeled as not financial advice.
Paid educational content and courses built around how the agent framework reasons.

steal_this: Build an 'explain this stock from four angles' web tool for beginners. Sell information and education, never trades, and keep the compliance disclaimer front and centre.
